study_info.purpose: Enhanced Rock Weathering simulations with uniform basalt application
study_info.erw_strategy: Uniform 50 t/ha/yr application rate for direct forest vs agricultural comparison

erw_design.rationale: Uniform rate allows direct comparison between forest and agricultural sites
erw_design.research_question: How do forest vs agricultural sites respond differently to the same ERW treatment?

site_differences.additional_inputs: Small fertilizer component for agricultural sites

comparison_framework.primary_comparison: Forest vs Agricultural response to identical ERW rate
secondary_factors: Soil property differences from CSV data

expected_outcomes.hypothesis: Agricultural sites will show faster initial weathering but forest sites may have more sustained long-term effects
expected_outcomes.co2_sequestration: Direct comparison of forest vs agricultural CO2 capture efficiency
expected_outcomes.soil_chemistry: Different pH and nutrient evolution patterns by land use type
expected_outcomes.weathering_kinetics: Faster kinetics in agricultural (tilling) vs sustained in forest (organic acids)
